Send to Issue:
Manage custom tags (shared across Standup, Daily To-Do & Issue)
One-time: migrate old tag catalogs into the shared one

Standup, Daily To-Do, and Issue used to each keep their own separate custom-tag catalog. Custom tags created before 2026-08-10 are sitting in those three old collections and won't show up in any tag dropdown until this runs once. Preview first - it changes nothing - then run it for real. Safe to run more than once.


      

      
      

        One-time: remove auto-granted Hardware access & freeze existing permissions
        
Every tab/mode/action list used to treat a null field as "everything, including anything added later" - which is how the brand-new Hardware mode ended up silently granted to every existing user. This backfills an explicit permission snapshot for any account still on that old null convention (preserving what they already had) and strips Hardware specifically from everyone. From then on, a new tab/mode/action stays unassigned until you grant it by hand. Preview first - it changes nothing - then run it for real. Safe to run more than once.
